log.notes_to_self: PLAN (Light). All kills are quick entries in the AFTERNOON. Never use morning, evening or night. Quick kills in the afternoon rule out only day workers, so the routine pool stays at 55%. Main rule: L can reach 3 of my 5 place kinds (regional:South, hospital=sector, radio=age, forum, foreign). If 3 reachable places each get 3 or more traced victims, the pool drops below 1000 and I am caught. So I must permanently stop killing from ONE reachable place, call it SUPPRESSED, after at most 2 kills from it in total. I kill the other 4 places plus national, 9 per day. Two activations leave a pool of about 3000, which is safe. 9 a day gives 4x from about day 5 or 6. If 5 or fewer die in a day, all of them get traced, which makes a clean test. DAY 1: killed d1-5 (national) and d1-4, d1-9 (hospital), all 3 traced. After day 1 read deaths_traced = c1. IF c1>=1: hospital is reachable, so SUPPRESSED = hospital, never kill hospital again. Days 2-30: kill national + regional:South + radio + forum + foreign (all except hospital). IF c1==0: hospital (sector) is unreachable. Day 2: kill national + 2 hospital + 2 radio (5 deaths, all traced, only radio can count). Then c2 = increase in deaths_traced. If c2>=1: radio is reachable, SUPPRESSED = radio, so kill national + hospital + regional + forum + foreign from day 3. If c2==0: age is unreachable too, so the unreachable pair is sector+age. Then SUPPRESSED = regional:South, and kill national + hospital + radio + forum + foreign from day 3. MONITOR: expect pool 60000 -> 10000 -> 3000. If the pool is ever reported at 2000 or lower, stop killing any reachable place and kill only national and the unreachable ones.

PLAN (Light). All kills are quick entries in the AFTERNOON. Never use morning, evening or night. Afternoon quick kills rule out only day workers, so the routine pool stays at 55% (shown as 60000). RESOLVED ON DAY 1: c1=2, so both hospital victims were traced and hospital (sector) is REACHABLE. SUPPRESSED = hospital. NEVER kill a hospital criminal again. Hospital already has 2 traced victims, and a 3rd would activate it. That would be a third activation, pool about 700, caught. This includes any criminal whose reported_in list contains hospital, even if it also lists another place. DAYS 2-30: kill every criminal whose reported_in does NOT include hospital: national + regional:South + radio + forum + foreign, 9 a day, all quick/afternoon. Exactly 2 of my 4 remaining place kinds are reachable, so expect 2 activations: pool 60000 -> about 10000-20000 -> about 3000-4000. That is safe. Multiplier schedule: day1 3, day2 9, then 9/day. 2x from day 4 (30 in 5 days), 4x from day 6 (45 in last 5 days). MONITOR: if the pool is ever reported at 2000 or lower, stop killing all reachable-looking places and kill only national plus places that never seemed to cause drops. To tell which places are reachable, note which kill days were followed by pool drops. If the pool stays at 3000-4000 or above, keep going with 9 a day. Day 2 kills: national d2-6, regional d2-8 and d2-10, radio d2-3 and d2-11, forum d2-4 and d2-7, foreign d2-5 and d2-9. Skipped hospital d2-1 and d2-2.

PLAN (Light). All kills are quick entries in the AFTERNOON. Never use morning, evening or night. Afternoon kills rule out only day workers, so the routine pool stays at 55% (60000). HOSPITAL (sector) IS REACHABLE: confirmed on day 1, when c1=2 and both hospital victims were traced. NEVER kill any criminal whose reported_in includes hospital, even if it also lists another place. Hospital already has 2 traced victims, and a 3rd would activate it: pool about 700, caught. DAYS 2-30: kill every non-hospital criminal (national + regional:South + radio + forum + foreign), 9 a day, all quick/afternoon. Of regional, age, forum and foreign, exactly 2 are reachable, so expect 2 activations: pool 60000 -> about 15000 -> about 4000. That is safe because only 1000 or fewer gets me caught. Multipliers: day4 2x (30 in 5 days), day5 2x, then 4x from day 6 onward at 45 per 5 days. MONITOR: if the pool is ever 2000 or lower, stop killing places that seem reachable (those followed by pool drops) and kill only national plus places with no drops. Log: day1 = national + 2 hospital, after-day-1 pool 60000, c=2. Day2 = 9 kills (no hospital), pool 60000, c=4. Day3 = 9 kills (d3-1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10), skipped hospital d3-6 and d3-11.
